name: A Sure Thing
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 16
body:
Drawbacks
A Sure Thing
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 16
Category Faction
Once per day, you gain a +2 bonus on a single attack roll against an evil-aligned creature. If the creature is not evil-aligned, this ability is wasted with no benefit.
